events.title: Christmas Market — Spetchley Park Gardens
events.body: Spetchley Park Gardens will host a free Christmas market on 14 and 15 November, with a mix of indoor and outdoor stalls.

news.title: Landline switch-off to affect parts of Worcestershire
news.body: Openreach has named eight Worcestershire areas affected by a nationwide shift from old copper landlines to full fibre broadband, as the UK moves towards digital phone services.

news.title: Police appeal after night burglaries in Inkberrow area
news.body: Police have issued an appeal for information following a series of burglaries in Inkberrow and Bradley Green, in which windows were smashed to gain entry overnight.

news.title: Worcestershire stockpiles salt for winter gritting
news.body: Worcestershire is stockpiling 17,000 tonnes of salt and has a fleet of 36 gritters ready as highways bosses prepare for winter storms.

news.title: Worcestershire County Council faces £85m budget gap
news.body: Worcestershire County Council has begun setting its 2027/28 budget, warning of tough choices ahead as it works to close an £85m funding gap.

notices.title: Road Closure — Ab Lench Road, Church Lench
notices.body: Ab Lench Road, Church Lench will be closed on Monday 26 October for Openreach streetworks, with a diversion route in place via Main Street.

notices.title: Road Closure — Badgers Hill to Handgate Lane, Sheriffs Lench
notices.body: Badgers Hill to Handgate Lane, Sheriffs Lench, closed from Tuesday 27 October to Sunday 29 November for Severn Trent Water works, with a diversion via Handgate Lane, Church Lench.

notices.title: Brookdale, Harvington — water works
notices.body: Severn Trent Water works at Brookdale, Harvington, from Wednesday 21 to Friday 23 October; no carriageway incursion expected and delays are unlikely.

notices.title: Hughes Close, Harvington — Openreach works
notices.body: Openreach works at Hughes Close, Harvington, from Thursday 22 to Monday 26 October; some carriageway incursion but delays are unlikely.

notices.title: Leys Road, Harvington — water works
notices.body: Severn Trent Water works at Leys Road, Harvington, from Wednesday 21 to Friday 23 October; no carriageway incursion expected.
